pairs: Similiter et mulieres subditæ sint viris suis:
Similarly also, wives should be subject to their husbands, so that,
ut etsi qui non credunt verbo,
even if some do not believe the Word,
per mulierem conversationem sine verbo lucrifiant:
they may benefit without the Word, through the behavior of these wives,
considerantes in timore castam conversationem vestram.
as they consider with fear your chaste behavior.
For you, there should be no unnecessary adornment of the hair,
or the wearing of ornate clothing.
sed qui absconditus est cordis homo,
you should be a hidden person of the heart,
with the incorruptibility of a quiet and meek spirit,
qui est in conspectu Dei locuples.
rich in the sight of God.
being subject to their own husbands.
well-behaved and unafraid of any disturbance.
quasi infirmiori vasculo muliebri impartientes honorem,
you husbands should live with them in accord with knowledge,
bestowing honor on the female as the weaker vessel and as co-heirs of the life of grace,
so that your prayers may not be hindered.
And finally, may you all be of one mind:
to the contrary, repaying with blessings.
For to this you have been called,
so that you may possess the inheritance of a blessing.
For whoever wants to love life
and to see good days should restrain his tongue from evil,
et labia ejus ne loquantur dolum.
so that they utter no deceit.
Let him turn away from evil,
For the eyes of the Lord are upon the just,
et aures ejus in preces eorum:
and his ears are with their prayers,
vultus autem Domini super facientes mala.
but the countenance of the Lord is upon those who do evil.
Et quis est qui vobis noceat,
And who is it who can harm you,
if you are zealous in what is good?
Sed et si quid patimini propter justitiam, beati.
And yet, even when you suffer something for the sake of justice,
you are blessed. So then, do not be afraid with their fear,
Dominum autem Christum sanctificate in cordibus vestris,
But sanctify Christ the Lord in your hearts,
parati semper ad satisfactionem omni poscenti vos rationem de ea, quæ in vobis est, spe.
being always ready to give an explanation to all who ask you the reason for that hope which is in you.
in whatever matter they may slander you,
qui calumniantur vestram bonam in Christo conversationem.
since they falsely accuse your good behavior in Christ.
Melius est enim benefacientes (si voluntas Dei velit) pati,
For it is better to suffer for doing good, if it is the will of God,
Quia et Christus semel pro peccatis nostris mortuus est,
For Christ also died once for our sins, the Just One on behalf of the unjust,
so that he might offer us to God,
mortificatus quidem carne, vivificatus autem spiritu.
in the flesh, but having been enlivened by the Spirit.
he preached to those who were in prison,
who had been unbelieving in past times,
quando exspectabant Dei patientiam in diebus Noë,
while they waited for the patience of God, as in the days of Noah,
when the ark was being built.
eight souls, were saved by water.
Quod et vos nunc similis formæ salvos fecit baptisma:
And now you also are saved, in a similar manner, by baptism,
not by the testimony of sordid flesh,
sed conscientiæ bonæ interrogatio in Deum per resurrectionem Jesu Christi.
but by the examination of a good conscience in God, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
He is at the right hand of God,
deglutiens mortem ut vitæ æternæ hæredes efficeremur:
profectus in cælum subjectis sibi angelis,
so that we may be made heirs to eternal life.
And since he has journeyed to heaven,
the Angels and powers and virtues are subject to him.
